parameters.name: FourthKey
parameters.description: The quaternary query condition. The value cannot be the same as the primary, secondary, or tertiary query condition.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: SecondaryKey
parameters.description: The secondary query condition. The value cannot be the same as the primary query condition.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection template to query.

parameters.name: ThirdKey
parameters.description: The tertiary query condition. The value cannot be the same as the primary or secondary query condition.
